# 32 SMILES Multispeciality Dental Clinics

> Premium dental healthcare and multispeciality clinical excellence in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. Founded in 2005.

## Quick Facts
- **Locations**: 9 Clinics across Bangalore (Indiranagar, Whitefield, Koramangala, Jayanagar, HSR Layout, Malleshwaram, JP Nagar, Electronic City, Yelahanka)
- **Key Specialities**: Root Canal Treatment (Endodontics), Invisalign & Clear Aligners (Orthodontics), 3D Guided Dental Implants (Implantology), Cosmetic Dentistry & Veneers, Wisdom Tooth Surgery (Oral Surgery), Laser Teeth Whitening
- **Experience**: 20+ Years of Dental Excellence
- **Verified Patients**: 15,000+ Happy Patients treated
- **Emergency Hotline**: +91 94827 12345 (24/7 Priority Emergency Triage)
- **Booking URL**: https://32-smiles-website.vercel.app/book-appointment
